item.title: Glide Stickpop 20cm - 105g
item.excerpt:
20 cm and 105g of weight.

Intermediate stickpop size that covers several situations with both heavy and lighter rods

Very simple to use, make liters of bubbles and amazing swimming action.

It needs inline hooks bkk diablo 9/0 or 11/0 or trebles from 3/0 to 4/0front and rear.
